Titles, paragraph order, description length, optional spatial fields, distribution count and distribution titles vary, not merely prefixes. Variable concepts and units are preserved per ID: a071/a072/a080 temperature+spoilage+microbes; a073 temperature+spoilage without microbes; a074 temperature+microbes without spoilage; a075 temperature only; a076 logistics mo

nth/site/count; a077 oat beverage with all three shelf-life variables; a078 all three in PDF only; a079 simulated versions of all three, never physical measurements. Core process/basis and required-format availability persist, and all nested descriptions associate their own format with the same per-record columns. However numeric examples and fictional locality/publisher are not preserved as literal facts: a071 storage temperature is 3.41 here, 7.69 in 39032 and 3.9 in 39033; a076 operations are 41/78/74. Thus these are not unchanged observation values under paraphrase. Full fact-preserving variation is not certified. a076 dairy-product gramm

atical scope and a079 empirical-sounding trial title are unresolved in this seed. No exact-identity review is requested for these records, no complete searchable record duplicates or answer-key/intent/grade leakage were observed, and no frozen no-answer conjunction is supported. Complete actual fields were read; omitted production queryContext text was not independently inspected, and downloadable bytes were not accessed. Verification is metadata content/format association only. Literal query paraphrases are absent, so paraphrase equivalence cannot be independently tested from this packet.

All ten seed versions and both counterparts were actually reviewed. Measurement concepts, units and explicit empirical/simulation distinctions survive: a073 still has only temperature/spoilage; a074 only temperature/microbes; a075 temperature alone; no omitted variable was supplied by topic. a076 remains month/site/operations logistics, a077 explicitly excludes dairy, a078 remains PDF-only and a079 simulation-only. CSV/JSON distributions repeat their per-record columns, and both PDFs of a078 carry the same three variables. Distribution count changes do not change format availability: for example a072 gains a third CSV, a073 has two distributi

ons here rather than three, and a078 has two PDFs rather than one in 39031. Textual variation is substantive in organization and length: a071 is distribution-led and short, a073 is much longer, a074 becomes one paragraph, and titles/locality/publisher are different. Exact numerical examples are not invariant: a072 temperature 7.38/2.73/6.39 and spoilage 8.84/12.15/8.93 across seeds. Full literal-fact preservation is therefore not certified, despite stable measurement schemas. The product-scope ambiguity in a076 persists, and a079's field-notes title creates an empirical provenance cue despite explicit simulation text. No identity-required rec

ords, complete searchable duplicates, answer-key/intent/grade leakage or no-answer conjunctions were observed. Review completeness covers all packet fields, not omitted queryContext copies, file bytes, or unavailable actual query paraphrases.

All ten records were compared across all three seeds. Core product/process/basis, variable concepts and units, and format constraints remain recognizable, with a076 now positively attaching dairy beverage to transport rather than putting it after a negated shelf-life clause. a079 has a neutral title here rather than the empirical-sounding titles in 39031/39032; its explicit simulation-only descriptions and all simulated-output distributions remain decisive, not empirical measurements. a071/a072/a080 retain three empirical shelf-life variables; a073 has no microbe measurement, a074 has no spoilage-time measurement, and a075 has neither. a077 r

etains positive oat subject and explicit no-dairy exclusion; a078 has only PDF tables containing all three measurements. and temperature 3.33/3.32/5.02.
